mapper.select: select i.path_id as bizKey, coalesce(sum(r.points), 0) as points from student_point_record r join learning_path_item i on i.item_id = r.biz_id and i.user_id = r.user_id where r.user_id = #{userId} and r.points > 0 and r.biz_type in ('PATH_TEST', 'PATH_NODE') group by i.path_id
select r.biz_id as bizKey, coalesce(sum(r.points), 0) as points from student_point_record r where r.user_id = #{userId} and r.points > 0 and r.biz_type = 'PATH_DONE' group by r.biz_id
